tool_schemas.name: get_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks for the account, optionally filtered by status, project/category membership, parent_task_id (subtasks), and due/scheduled/completed date ranges; results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and returned as a page of tasks with up to limit items and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter has an invalid value or format (including invalid ULID prefix/pattern, invalid enum, invalid date-time, or limit out of range). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; does not raise NOT_FOUND for missing project/category/parent IDs and simply returns an empty list when nothing matches.

parent_task_id.description: Filter tasks by parent task (tasks.id) ULID (subtasks of this task).

due_before.description: Include tasks with due_date earlier than this ISO datetime.

due_after.description: Include tasks with due_date later than this ISO datetime.

scheduled_before.description: Include tasks with scheduled_for earlier than this ISO datetime.

scheduled_after.description: Include tasks with scheduled_for later than this ISO datetime.

completed_before.description: Include tasks with completed_at earlier than this ISO datetime.

completed_after.description: Include tasks with completed_at later than this ISO datetime.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects (categories with type="project") for the account, optionally filtered by status/archived and by parent_category_id; results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and returned paged with up to limit items plus an opaque cursor for the next page when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, invalid ULID format for parent_category_id, or limit out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; missing parent_category_id does not raise NOT_FOUND and instead yields no matches.

archived.description: If provided, filter projects by archived flag.

parent_category_id.description: Filter projects by parent category (categories.id) ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_categories
tool_schemas.description: Lists categories for the account, optionally filtered by type, status/archived, and parent_category_id; results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and returned as a page of categories with up to limit items and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters are invalid (enum/value mismatch, invalid ULID format, invalid limit). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; non-existent parent_category_id does not raise NOT_FOUND and simply returns an empty list.

archived.description: If provided, filter categories by archived flag.

parent_category_id.description: Filter categories by parent category (categories.id) ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_due_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks that are due/overdue (due_date < now), optionally restricted to a project_id or category_id; returns up to limit tasks per page with an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if now is not a valid ISO date-time, if IDs are not valid ULIDs, or if limit is out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; unknown project/category IDs do not raise NOT_FOUND and instead return no tasks.

now.description: Override the current time (ISO datetime) used to determine what is overdue (due_date < now).

project_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks in a specific project (categories.id) ULID.

category_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks in a specific category (categories.id) ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of due/overdue tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_child_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists the immediate children of a parent task or project, returning both child tasks and sub-projects/categories; when recursive=true, it returns descendants (depth-first/expanded) as a paged list with up to limit items and an opaque cursor for the next page when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parent_id is missing, not a recognized task/category ID format, recursive is not boolean, or limit is out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND when parent_id is well-formed but does not exist or is not accessible to the account, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent task or project (tasks.id starting with am_tsk_… or categories.id starting with am_cat_…).

recursive.description: If true, recursively return all descendants (may be expensive).

limit.description: Maximum number of child items to return at once.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_all_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks for a specific scheduled local date (scheduled_for_date interpreted in the provided timezone), optionally restricted to a project_id or category_id; results are returned paged with up to limit tasks and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if scheduled_for_date is not YYYY-MM-DD, timezone is not a valid IANA name, IDs are not valid ULIDs, or limit is out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated; unknown project/category IDs do not raise NOT_FOUND and instead yield an empty list.

scheduled_for_date.description: Only include tasks scheduled on this local date (YYYY-MM-DD).

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used with scheduled_for_date (e.g., 'America/New_York').

project_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks in a specific project (categories.id) ULID.

category_id.description: Optionally restrict to tasks in a specific category (categories.id) ULID.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_labels
tool_schemas.description: Lists labels for the account, optionally filtered by status; results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and returned as a page of labels with up to limit items and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values or limit out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated.

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_goals
tool_schemas.description: Lists goals for the account, optionally filtered by status and target_date range (target_before/target_after); results are sorted by sort_by/sort_order and returned paged with up to limit goals and an opaque cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if enums are invalid, date-times are not valid ISO strings, or limit is out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not authenticated.

target_before.description: Include goals with target_date earlier than this ISO datetime.

target_after.description: Include goals with target_date later than this ISO datetime.

limit.description: Maximum number of goals to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_account_info
tool_schemas.description: Get account information from Amazing Marvin

tool_schemas.name: get_currently_tracked_item
tool_schemas.description: Use when beginning focused work on a task to measure time spent. Check current tracking status with get_currently_tracked_item() or time_tracking_summary(). Stop tracking with stop_time_tracking(task_id).

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task for your Amazing Marvin account and returns the created task record, optionally assigning it to a project/category, setting due/scheduled dates, priority, notes, and/or attaching it under a parent task as a subtask. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, `title` is empty, `priority` is not in 1–5, date fields are not valid ISO/`YYYY-MM-DD`, or IDs do not match the expected ULID format; raises NOT_FOUND if `project_id`, `category_id`, or `parent_task_id` refers to an item that doesn’t exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the referenced project/category/task, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if task creation is rate-limited for your account.

project_id.description: Optional project (category) ULID to assign the task to.

category_id.description: Optional category ULID for organizing the task.

due_date.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parent_task_id.description: Optional parent task ULID to create this task as a subtask.

scheduled_for.description: Optional scheduled datetime for the task (ISO 8601).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_task(title, project_id=None, category_id=None, due_date=None, note=None, parent_task_id=None, scheduled_for=None, priority=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0477000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0477000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    endpoint = "create_task"

    def _iso(dt):
        if dt is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(dt, str):
            return dt
        try:
            return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        except Exception:
            return str(dt)

    def _log(status, credential_id=None, error=None):
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        t1 = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        row = {
            "id": f"am_req_{int(t1.timestamp()*1000)}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_id": credential_id,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": (error or {}).get("code") if isinstance(error, dict) else None,
            "error_message": (error or {}).get("message") if isinstance(error, dict) else None,
            "latency_ms": int((t1 - t0).total_seconds() * 1000),
            "created_at": _iso(t1),
        }
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_log.json", logs)

    # Ambient auth
    accounts = _load("accounts.json")
    if not isinstance(accounts, list):
        accounts = []
    account = None
    for a in accounts:
        if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("status") == "active":
            account = a
            break
    if account is None:
        for a in accounts:
            if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("status") in ("error", "revoked", "active"):
                account = a
                break
    if account is None:
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No authenticated account context is available.")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e
    account_id = account.get("id")

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(title, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title must be a string.", field="title")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e
    ttl = title.strip()
    if len(ttl) < 1 or len(ttl) > 500:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title length must be between 1 and 500.", field="title")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

    cat_pat = re.compile(r"^am_cat_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$")
    tsk_pat = re.compile(r"^am_tsk_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{10,}$")

    if project_id is not None and (not isinstance(project_id, str) or not cat_pat.match(project_id)):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id is malformed.", field="project_id")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e
    if category_id is not None and (not isinstance(category_id, str) or not cat_pat.match(category_id)):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "category_id is malformed.", field="category_id")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e
    if parent_task_id is not None and (not isinstance(parent_task_id, str) or not tsk_pat.match(parent_task_id)):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "parent_task_id is malformed.", field="parent_task_id")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

    if note is not None and not isinstance(note, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "note must be a string.", field="note")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

    if priority is not None:
        if not isinstance(priority, int) or priority not in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "priority must be one of 1,2,3,4,5.", field="priority")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

    # Parse/normalize dates
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    tz_offset_min = account.get("default_timezone_offset_minutes")
    if tz_offset_min is None:
        tz_offset_min = 0
    if not isinstance(tz_offset_min, int) or tz_offset_min < -840 or tz_offset_min > 840:
        # If account row invalid, fall back to UTC rather than failing create.
        tz_offset_min = 0
    acct_tz = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(minutes=tz_offset_min))

    due_dt = None
    if due_date is not None:
        if not isinstance(due_date, str):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "due_date must be a string in YYYY-MM-DD.", field="due_date")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        try:
            d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(due_date)
        except ValueError:
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "due_date must be valid ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.", field="due_date")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        # Normalize to 00:00:00 in account timezone, stored as UTC ISO datetime.
        local_mid = datetime.datetime(d.year, d.month, d.day, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=acct_tz)
        due_dt = local_mid.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    sched_dt = None
    if scheduled_for is not None:
        if not isinstance(scheduled_for, str):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "scheduled_for must be an ISO 8601 datetime string.", field="scheduled_for")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        try:
            s = scheduled_for.replace("Z", "+00:00")
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
            if dt.tzinfo is None:
                # Treat naive as UTC
                dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            sched_dt = dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        except ValueError:
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "scheduled_for must be valid ISO 8601 datetime.", field="scheduled_for")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

    categories = _load("categories.json")
    if not isinstance(categories, list):
        categories = []
    tasks = _load("tasks.json")
    if not isinstance(tasks, list):
        tasks = []

    def _find_cat(cid):
        for c in categories:
            if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("id") == cid and c.get("account_id") == account_id:
                return c
        return None

    if project_id is not None:
        c = _find_cat(project_id)
        if c is None:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "project_id does not reference an existing category for this account.", field="project_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        if c.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Cannot assign task to a deleted project.", field="project_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        if c.get("type") != "project":
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id must reference a category with type='project'.", field="project_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

    if category_id is not None:
        c = _find_cat(category_id)
        if c is None:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "category_id does not reference an existing category for this account.", field="category_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e
        if c.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Cannot assign task to a deleted category.", field="category_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

    if parent_task_id is not None:
        pt = None
        for t in tasks:
            if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("id") == parent_task_id and t.get("account_id") == account_id:
                pt = t
                break
        if pt is None:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "parent_task_id does not reference an existing task for this account.", field="parent_task_id")
            _log("error", error=e["error"])
            return e

    # Unique(account_id, am_item_id) - generate a new upstream-like id; ensure no collision.
    def _new_ulidish(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        # 16 chars payload based on ms time + counter-like entropy
        ms = int(now.timestamp() * 1000)
        base = []
        x = ms
        for _ in range(10):
            base.append(alphabet[x % len(alphabet)])
            x //= len(alphabet)
        base = "".join(reversed(base))
        # add 6 chars of pseudo-random derived from pid and len(tasks)
        mix = (os.getpid() * 2654435761 + len(tasks) * 1013904223 + ms) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        extra = []
        y = mix
        for _ in range(6):
            extra.append(alphabet[y % len(alphabet)])
            y //= len(alphabet)
        return f"{prefix}_{base}{''.join(extra)}"

    existing_am_ids = set()
    for t in tasks:
        if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("account_id") == account_id and isinstance(t.get("am_item_id"), str):
            existing_am_ids.add(t["am_item_id"])

    am_item_id = _new_ulidish("am_itm")
    tries = 0
    while am_item_id in existing_am_ids and tries < 10:
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        am_item_id = _new_ulidish("am_itm")
        tries += 1
    if am_item_id in existing_am_ids:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Could not generate a unique upstream item id.")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

    # Local primary id follows tool pattern: am_tsk_...
    existing_ids = set(t.get("id") for t in tasks if isinstance(t, dict))
    new_id = _new_ulidish("am_tsk")
    tries = 0
    while new_id in existing_ids and tries < 10:
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        new_id = _new_ulidish("am_tsk")
        tries += 1
    if new_id in existing_ids:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Could not generate a unique task id.")
        _log("error", error=e["error"])
        return e

    created_at = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    row = {
        "id": new_id,
        "account_id": account_id,
        "am_item_id": am_item_id,
        "title": ttl,
        "note": note,
        "project_id": project_id,
        "category_id": category_id,
        "parent_task_id": parent_task_id,
        "due_date": due_dt,
        "scheduled_for": sched_dt,
        "priority": priority,
        "status": "active",
        "completed_at": None,
        "completion_timezone_offset_minutes": None,
        "reward_points_claimed": False,
        "reward_points_claimed_at": None,
        "created_at": _iso(created_at),
        "updated_at": _iso(created_at),
    }

    tasks.append(row)
    _save("tasks.json", tasks)
    _log("ok")
    return row

tool_schemas.name: mark_task_done
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified task as completed and returns the updated task (including completion metadata), using `timezone_offset` to compute the completion date in your local time; if `claim_reward_points` is true, this also claims any available reward points for that task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `timezone_offset` is missing/invalid, `item_id` is malformed, or the task is not eligible to be completed; raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the task is already completed or in a state that cannot transition to done, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the task, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if completion actions are rate-limited.

item_id.description: Task ULID to mark as done.

timezone_offset.description: Timezone offset in minutes from UTC at completion time (e.g., -480).

claim_reward_points.description: Whether to mark reward points as claimed when completing the task.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def mark_task_done(item_id, timezone_offset, claim_reward_points=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, base64, time, re
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0477000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0477000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "mark_task_done"

    def _now_utc():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)

    def _iso(dt):
        if dt is None: return None
        if isinstance(dt, str): return dt
        if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _log(status_code, account_id=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list): logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": "req_" + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(os.urandom(12)).decode("ascii").rstrip("="),
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "account_id": account_id,
            "status": status_code,
            "latency_ms": int(round((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            "timestamp": _iso(_now_utc()),
            "meta": meta or {}
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # Validate inputs: pattern per schema, but do not over-reject: accept any non-empty string
    if not isinstance(item_id, str) or not item_id.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "item_id must be a non-empty string", field="item_id")
        _log("error", meta={"error": e["error"]})
        return e
    if not isinstance(timezone_offset, int) or timezone_offset < -840 or timezone_offset > 840:
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "timezone_offset must be an integer between -840 and 840", field="timezone_offset")
        _log("error", meta={"error": e["error"]})
        return e
    if claim_reward_points is not None and not isinstance(claim_reward_points, bool):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "claim_reward_points must be a boolean", field="claim_reward_points")
        _log("error", meta={"error": e["error"]})
        return e

    tasks = _load("tasks.json")
    if not isinstance(tasks, list): tasks = []
    accounts = _load("accounts.json")
    if not isinstance(accounts, list): accounts = []

    # Find task (no ambient "current account" parameter exists; resolve by matching the task id)
    task = None
    task_idx = None
    for i, t in enumerate(tasks):
        if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("id") == item_id:
            task = t
            task_idx = i
            break
    if not task:
        # do not treat random ids as validation errors; return NOT_FOUND
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Task not found", task_id=item_id)
        _log("error", meta={"error": e["error"], "item_id": item_id})
        return e

    account_id = task.get("account_id")
    account = None
    for a in accounts:
        if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id") == account_id:
            account = a
            break
    if not account:
        e = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No authenticated account context is available for this task.")
        _log("error", meta={"error": e["error"], "task_id": item_id})
        return e

    if task.get("status") == "deleted":
        e = _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Deleted tasks cannot be marked done", task_id=item_id, from_status="deleted", to_status="done")
        _log("error", account_id=account_id, meta={"error": e["error"]})
        return e

    now = _now_utc()
    # Idempotent if already done: do not change completed_at unless it is missing (but constraint requires it)
    changed = False
    if task.get("status") != "done":
        task["status"] = "done"
        task["completed_at"] = _iso(now)
        task["completion_timezone_offset_minutes"] = timezone_offset
        changed = True
    else:
        # Ensure completion fields satisfy constraints; if missing, repair
        if not task.get("completed_at"):
            task["completed_at"] = _iso(now)
            changed = True
        if task.get("completion_timezone_offset_minutes") is None:
            task["completion_timezone_offset_minutes"] = timezone_offset
            changed = True

    # Reward points claim optionally (enforce: must be done and not already claimed)
    if claim_reward_points:
        if task.get("status") != "done":
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Reward points can only be claimed for completed tasks", task_id=item_id)
            _log("error", account_id=account_id, meta={"error": e["error"]})
            return e
        if task.get("reward_points_claimed") is True:
            # cannot be claimed twice
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Reward points already claimed for this task", task_id=item_id)
            _log("error", account_id=account_id, meta={"error": e["error"]})
            return e
        task["reward_points_claimed"] = True
        task["reward_points_claimed_at"] = _iso(now)
        changed = True

    task["updated_at"] = _iso(now)

    if changed:
        tasks[task_idx] = task
        _save("tasks.json", tasks)

    resp = {"object": "task", "data": task}
    _log("ok", account_id=account_id, meta={"task_id": item_id, "changed": changed, "claim_reward_points": bool(claim_reward_points)})
    return resp

tool_schemas.name: test_api_connection
tool_schemas.description: Test the API connection and credentials. Use when troubleshooting connection issues or verifying API setup. Returns "OK" if successful or error details if failed.

tool_schemas.name: start_time_tracking
tool_schemas.description: Starts a time tracking session against the given task and returns the created (running) time track/session; `started_at` defaults to now when omitted and `note` is stored with the session. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is malformed or `started_at` is not a valid ISO 8601 datetime; raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if a timer is already running and the backend does not allow starting another running session, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the task, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if time tracking actions are rate-limited.

task_id.description: Task ULID to start tracking time against.

started_at.description: Optional explicit start datetime (ISO 8601); defaults to now.

note.description: Optional note to attach to the time tracking session.

tool_schemas.name: stop_time_tracking
tool_schemas.description: Stops the currently running time tracking session for the given task and returns the updated (stopped) session; `stopped_at` defaults to now when omitted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is malformed or `stopped_at` is not a valid ISO 8601 datetime; raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist or there is no matching running session to stop. Raises CONFLICT if the session is already stopped/deleted or `stopped_at` is earlier than the session start, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the task/session, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if time tracking actions are rate-limited.

task_id.description: Task ULID whose currently running timer should be stopped.

stopped_at.description: Optional explicit stop datetime (ISO 8601); defaults to now.

tool_schemas.name: get_time_tracks
tool_schemas.description: Lists time tracking sessions matching the provided filters and returns a page of sessions along with a pagination cursor when more results are available; results are limited by `limit` (1–200), ordered by `sort`, and you can fetch the next page by passing the returned `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any `task_ids` are malformed, `from`/`to` are not valid ISO 8601 datetimes, `from` is after `to`, `status`/`sort` are not allowed values, or `limit` is out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND if any referenced task does not exist (when `task_ids` is provided), FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the requested tasks/sessions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing is rate-limited.

task_ids.description: List of task ULIDs to fetch time tracking sessions for.

from.description: Optional start datetime (inclusive) to filter time tracking sessions.

to.description: Optional end datetime (exclusive) to filter time tracking sessions.

status.description: Optional status filter for time tracking sessions.

limit.description: Maximum number of time tracking sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort.description: Sort order for returned time tracking sessions.

tool_schemas.name: claim_reward_points
tool_schemas.description: Claims reward points for a completed task and returns the updated task (or reward status) reflecting that points have been claimed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_id` is malformed or the task is not eligible for claiming (e.g., not completed or no reward available); raises NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if reward points were already claimed, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the task, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if reward actions are rate-limited.

task_id.description: Task ULID to claim reward points for (e.g., am_tsk_01H8...).

tool_schemas.name: get_kudos_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns your current kudos/achievement status for the account (including any available progress/summary fields exposed by the backend). Raises FORBIDDEN if the account is not authorized to view kudos information, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the endpoint is rate-limited. This endpoint does not take parameters; any provided input is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR.

tool_schemas.name: create_project
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project (category) and returns the created project record, optionally nesting it under `parent_category_id`, setting `color`, and/or creating it archived. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `title` is missing/empty, IDs are malformed, or `archived`/`color` values fail validation; raises NOT_FOUND if `parent_category_id` does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the parent cannot accept children due to its state, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the parent category, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if project creation is rate-limited.

parent_category_id.description: Optional parent category/project ULID to nest this project under.

color.description: Optional project color (vendor-defined string, e.g., hex code or named color).

archived.description: Whether the project should be created archived.

tool_schemas.name: create_project_with_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Creates a project and one or more tasks inside it in a single operation, returning the created project plus the list of created tasks (in request order). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project` or `tasks` is missing, any task is missing `title`, any IDs are malformed, or any date/priority fields are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if `parent_category_id`, any `category_id`, or any `parent_task_id` refers to a non-existent item. Raises CONFLICT if requested nesting/state transitions are not allowed (e.g., creating subtasks under an invalid parent), FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to referenced parents/categories, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if bulk creation is rate-limited.

parent_category_id.description: Optional parent category/project ULID to nest this project under.

color.description: Optional project color (vendor-defined string, e.g., hex code or named color).

archived.description: Whether the project should be created archived.

category_id.description: Optional category ULID to associate the task with.

parent_task_id.description: Optional parent task ULID to create a subtask under.

tasks.description: Tasks to create inside the newly created project.

tool_schemas.name: get_project_overview
tool_schemas.description: When `project_id` is provided, returns a detailed overview for that single project/category; when omitted, returns a paged list overview of projects filtered by `include_archived`/`status`, limited by `limit` (1–200), and paginated via an opaque `cursor` returned with each page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is malformed, `status`/`sort` are invalid, or `limit` is out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND if `project_id` does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the requested project(s), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if listing is rate-limited.

project_id.description: Optional project/category ULID to fetch details for; if omitted, returns a project list overview.

include_archived.description: Whether to include archived projects in list/overview results.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (for list mode).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page (for list mode).

sort.description: Field to sort by (for list mode).

tool_schemas.name: get_daily_productivity_overview
tool_schemas.description: Returns a per-day productivity overview for the provided local calendar date (defaults to today), including scheduled items and day-level rollups interpreted in the account timezone unless an IANA `timezone` override is provided. It returns a single summary object (not a paged list). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid date or timezone, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to access the account.

date.description: Day to summarize in account timezone (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to today if omitted.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name to interpret the date boundary (overrides account timezone).

tool_schemas.name: batch_create_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple tasks in one request and returns the created task records in the same order as provided. Each task is validated for required fields and supported attributes, and association fields (`project_id`, `category_id`, `parent_task_id`) are applied when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `tasks` is empty, a task is missing `title`, an ID does not match the required pattern, or a field value is out of range (e.g., `priority` not in 1–5); raises NOT_FOUND if a referenced project/category/parent task does not exist, and CONFLICT if a task cannot be created due to an incompatible relationship (e.g., parent cannot be used as specified).

project_id.description: Optional project ULID to associate the task with.

category_id.description: Optional category ULID to associate the task with.

parent_task_id.description: Optional parent task ULID to create a subtask under.

tool_schemas.name: batch_mark_done
tool_schemas.description: Marks all provided tasks as completed and returns an updated result for each task id, applying `completed_at` (defaults to now) and optional `completion_timezone_offset_minutes` to each completion event. This operation is not paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `task_ids` is empty, any id is malformed, or timestamps/offsets are invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if any task id does not exist, and CONFLICT if a task cannot transition to done (e.g., already deleted).

task_ids.description: List of task ULIDs to mark done.

completed_at.description: Optional completion timestamp to set for all tasks (ISO 8601); defaults to now if omitted.

completion_timezone_offset_minutes.description: Optional timezone offset in minutes to record with completion.

tool_schemas.name: time_tracking_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns a summary of time tracking sessions, optionally filtered by `task_id`, `status`, and an inclusive `started_at` range (`started_at_gte`/`started_at_lte`). The response includes aggregated totals and the matching sessions for the filters (not paged unless explicitly documented elsewhere). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, invalid status values, invalid timestamps, or an invalid time range (e.g., `started_at_gte` after `started_at_lte`); raises NOT_FOUND if `task_id` is provided but does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if access to the account data is not permitted.

task_id.description: Filter summary to a single task (Amazing Marvin task id in this backend).

status.description: Filter time tracking sessions by status.

started_at_gte.description: Only include sessions started at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

started_at_lte.description: Only include sessions started at or before this timestamp (inclusive).

tool_schemas.name: get_completed_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks completed in the recent window (past 7 days) with optional filtering by `project_id`, `category_id`, and `include_deleted`, returning results sorted by `sort`. Results are paged with `limit` (1–200) and an opaque `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, invalid `limit`, invalid `sort`, or an invalid cursor; raises NOT_FOUND if the specified project/category does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the account.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include tasks with status=deleted in results.

project_id.description: Filter to tasks belonging to a specific project (categories.id).

category_id.description: Filter to tasks belonging to a specific category (categories.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of completed tasks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_productivity_summary_for_time_range
tool_schemas.description: Returns a productivity summary for the time range [`start`, `end`) with optional filtering to a project/category and optional inclusion of time tracking totals. It returns a single summary object (not a paged list). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid timestamps, `start` not before `end`, or malformed ids; raises NOT_FOUND if the specified project/category does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the account.

start.description: Start of the time range (inclusive) used for the productivity summary.

end.description: End of the time range (exclusive) used for the productivity summary.

project_id.description: Filter summary to a specific project (categories.id).

category_id.description: Filter summary to a specific category (categories.id).

include_time_tracking.description: Whether to include time tracking totals in the returned summary.

tool_schemas.name: get_completed_tasks_for_date
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks completed on the given local calendar date as interpreted in the account timezone or an optional IANA `timezone` override, with optional filtering by `project_id`/`category_id` and ordering by `sort`. Results are paged with `limit` (1–200) and an opaque `cursor` to fetch subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid date/timezone, malformed ids, invalid `limit`/`sort`, or an invalid cursor; raises NOT_FOUND if the specified project/category does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller cannot access the account.

date.description: Local calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) to retrieve completed tasks for.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used to interpret the provided date (defaults to account timezone if omitted).

project_id.description: Filter to tasks belonging to a specific project (categories.id).

category_id.description: Filter to tasks belonging to a specific category (categories.id).

limit.description: Maximum number of completed tasks to return for the date.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_task
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single task by tasks.id for the current account. Returns the task if it exists and is not deleted; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist for the account, and with VALIDATION_ERROR if the id format is invalid.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task by tasks.id for the current account. Supports changing core fields and driving lifecycle transitions (active/done/deleted) by setting status; when transitioning to done, completed_at is set to now and completion_timezone_offset_minutes uses the provided value or the account default. Returns the updated task; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the task does not exist for the account, CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values/foreign keys.

project_id.description: Set/replace project (categories.id) ULID; must exist for the account and not be deleted.

category_id.description: Set/replace category (categories.id) ULID; must exist for the account and not be deleted.

parent_task_id.description: Set/replace parent task (tasks.id) ULID; must exist for the account and not be deleted.

due_date.description: Set due_date (ISO-8601) or null to clear; date-only inputs normalize to 00:00:00 in account timezone.

scheduled_for.description: Set scheduled_for (ISO-8601) or null to clear; date-only inputs normalize to 00:00:00 in account timezone.

status.description: Desired lifecycle state for the task. Transition rules apply; setting to 'done' stamps completion fields.

completion_timezone_offset_minutes.description: Timezone offset in minutes to store when marking done; used only when transitioning to status='done'.

tool_schemas.name: update_category
tool_schemas.description: Updates a category/project by categories.id for the current account, including lifecycle transitions (active/archived/deleted). Returns the updated category; refuses with NOT_FOUND if it does not exist for the account, CONFLICT if the requested transition is not allowed, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values or invalid parent_category_id.

parent_category_id.description: Set/replace parent category (categories.id) ULID; must exist for the account and not be deleted.

archived.description: Set archived flag (supported for categories/projects that are not deleted).

status.description: Desired lifecycle state. Transition rules apply; deleted is terminal.

metadata.name: Amazing Marvin MCP
metadata.description: This backend stores Amazing Marvin productivity data for a single account: tasks (including hierarchy), categories/projects, labels, goals, and time tracking sessions. The main workflows are creating/organizing tasks and projects, completing tasks (with optional reward points), and tracking time aga
